title: 第14章 入职
novel_title: 重生官场：我真的不想再升职了
content_zh:
“来来来，大家先停一下，我给大家介绍一位新同事。”

    县委办副主任汪荣华带着梁惟石来到办公室，轻拍了两下手掌，示意下属们暂时放下手头工作。

    “大家好，我叫梁惟石，新人一个，以后还请大家多多关照。”

    梁惟石十分礼貌地做了自我介绍。

    随后汪副主任带头鼓掌，表示对新同事加入的热烈欢迎。

    “小梁，这是你的位置。工作上有什么不明白的，可以问大家，当然也可以问我，我的办公室就在隔壁。”汪荣华指了指靠墙的办公桌，笑着说道。

    “谢谢主任，主任您快忙吧！”梁惟石连忙点头感谢道。

    他觉得汪副主任这个人还不错，没什么领导架子，挺平易近人的。

    以后摸鱼归摸鱼，能和领导搞好关系还是尽量搞好关系。

    汪副主任走后，办公室里又恢复了繁忙的节奏，大家查资料的查资料，整理档案的整理档案，写稿子的写稿子。

    只有梁惟石这个新丁，坐在自己的位置上，慢条斯理地整理着自己的个人物品。

    “小梁，能不能请你帮我打下档案目录，刚才学校老师来电话，说我家孩子发烧了，让我赶紧过去。”

    坐在对面的女同事徐丹在接完电话之后，不禁左右为难，张副主任追着要年初到现在的文书档案，但孩子又不能不管，迫不得已她只能向梁惟石张口求助。

    “就是按你整理好的文件顺序输入文件标题，然后标注页码对吧？嗯嗯，那我先替你整理着，等你回来再检查一遍看行不行。”

    梁惟石问明情况之后，很痛快地答应下来。

    大家都是同事，何况人家真有难处，能帮就帮一把。

    没办法，他从来都是这么的心地善良乐于助人还不求回报！

    然后没过多长时间，靠近窗户那边的男同事捧着一摞文件走了过来，颇为自来熟地吩咐道：“小梁，这是市委下发的关于加强党建工作的文件，你帮我复印几份，明天常委会议上要用。”

    另一旁的女同事见状不禁暗暗撇了撇嘴，很明显，邵承先这是看新来的帅小伙脾气好，想巧使唤人。

    而一向心地善良乐于助人不求回报梁惟石眼皮都没抬一下，面无表情地拒绝道：“抱歉，我正在帮徐姐整理档案，抽不出时间，你还是自己印吧！”

    邵承先怔住了，是的，他没想到对方会拒绝，而且还拒绝的这么干脆。
content_en:
"Come on, come on, everyone, please stop for a moment. Let me introduce you to a new colleague."

Wang Ronghua, deputy director of the County Party Committee Office, brought Liang Weishi to the office and patted his palms twice to signal his subordinates to put down their work temporarily.

"Hello everyone, my name is Liang Weishi. I am a new member. Please take good care of me in the future."

Liang Weishi introduced himself very politely.

Then Deputy Director Wang took the lead in applauding and expressed his warm welcome to the new colleagues.

"Xiao Liang, this is your position. If you don't understand anything about work, you can ask everyone, and of course you can ask me. My office is next door." Wang Ronghua pointed to the desk against the wall and said with a smile.

"Thank you, director. Director, please hurry up and get busy!" Liang Weishi nodded quickly and thanked him.

He thinks Deputy Director Wang is a pretty good person, he doesn't have any leadership arrogance and is quite approachable.

In the future, it will be better to have a good relationship with the leader if possible.

After Deputy Director Wang left, the office returned to a busy rhythm. Everyone was checking information, organizing files, and writing manuscripts.

Only Liang Weishi, the newbie, sat in his seat and arranged his personal belongings slowly.

"Xiaoliang, can you please help me get the file directory? The school teacher just called and said that my child has a fever and asked me to come over quickly."

Xu Dan, a female colleague sitting opposite, couldn't help but be in a dilemma after answering the phone. Deputy Director Zhang was chasing the paperwork from the beginning of the year to the present, but she couldn't ignore the child, so she had no choice but to ask Liang Weishi for help.

"Just enter the file titles in the order you have sorted them out, and then mark the page numbers, right? Well, then I'll sort it out for you first, and then check it again when you come back to see if it's okay."

After Liang Weishi asked about the situation, he readily agreed.

We are all colleagues, not to mention that if someone is really in trouble, I would like to help if I can.

No way, he has always been so kind-hearted and helpful without asking for anything in return!

Not long after, a male colleague near the window came over with a stack of documents and said in a familiar voice: "Xiao Liang, this is a document issued by the Municipal Party Committee on strengthening party building work. Please make a few copies for me. We will use it at the Standing Committee meeting tomorrow."

The female colleague on the other side couldn't help but curled her lips secretly when she saw this. It was obvious that Shao Chengxian saw the new handsome guy's good temper and wanted to manipulate him skillfully.

Liang Weishi, who was always kind-hearted and willing to help others without expecting anything in return, refused without even raising his eyelids and said expressionlessly: "Sorry, I'm helping Sister Xu sort out the files. I can't spare the time. You'd better print it yourself!"

Shao Cheng was stunned. Yes, he didn't expect that the other party would refuse, and he would refuse so simply.
